short_sentences.zh: 我週末為了好玩寫了一個小型 CLI 工具，用來自動化解析日誌。

words.meaning_zh: 名 休息 / 動 休息

short_sentences.zh: 在深入架構審查之前，我们先休息十分鐘。

short_sentences.zh: 成人的入場費用是六歐元。

short_sentences.en: The payment gateway charges a small processing fee per transaction.
short_sentences.zh: 金流閘道會針對每筆交易收取一筆小額處理費。

short_sentences.en: Mr. Taylor wasn't certain what his role in the project was.
short_sentences.zh: 泰勒先生不太確定自己在這項企劃中扮演什麼樣的角色。

short_sentences.en: Message queues play a critical role in decoupling asynchronous services.
short_sentences.zh: 訊息佇列在解耦非同步服務中扮演關鍵角色。

short_sentences.en: I've worked as a broadcaster for three decades.
short_sentences.zh: 我已經當廣播員 30 年了。

short_sentences.en: Enterprise software has shifted from monoliths to cloud-native systems over the past decade.
short_sentences.zh: 過去十年來，企業軟體已從單體式架構轉向雲原生系統。

short_sentences.zh: 飛機誤點三小時後終於起飛了。

short_sentences.en: A failed migration script caused a two-hour release delay.
short_sentences.zh: 失敗的遷移腳本導致發布延誤了兩小時。

packs.title: 名詞 Level 1 第 2 組（頁碼 92-93）

short_sentences.zh: 他想在廣告業找工作。

short_sentences.zh: 她專精於高併發後端工程領域。

words.meaning_zh: 名 民眾，大眾 / 形 公眾的，公共的

short_sentences.zh: 這座花園在冬天不開放民眾參觀。

short_sentences.en: We documented all breaking changes before opening the public beta.
short_sentences.zh: 在開放公開測試版之前，我們記錄了所有不相容變更。

short_sentences.zh: 「品質第一」是我們公司的座右銘。

short_sentences.en: Automated tests and code reviews keep our production code quality high.
short_sentences.zh: 自動化測試與程式碼審查讓我們的正式環境程式碼品質維持在高水準。

collocations.phrase: a welcome addition to the team
collocations.meaning_zh: 團隊中受歡迎的新成員／新功能

short_sentences.zh: 你是我們部門的重要新血。

short_sentences.zh: 即時告警是我們可觀測性技術堆疊中很有價值的補充。

short_sentences.en: I think buying that startup is a smart move.
short_sentences.zh: 我認為收購那間新創公司是明智之舉。

short_sentences.en: Migrating to containerized deployments was a smart move for scalability.
short_sentences.zh: 為了擴充性而遷移至容器化部署是明智之舉。

collocations.meaning_zh: 怎麼回事？出了什麼問題？

short_sentences.en: Lack of funds is another matter we must discuss.
short_sentences.zh: 缺乏資金是我們得討論的另一個問題。

short_sentences.en: Data consistency across microservices is a matter we need to resolve early.
short_sentences.zh: 微服務之間的資料一致性是我們需要及早解決的問題。

short_sentences.en: I have a weakness for sweet stuff.
short_sentences.zh: 我非常喜歡甜食。

short_sentences.en: We still maintain some legacy stuff from the first product version.
short_sentences.zh: 我們仍在維護第一版產品留下的部分舊系統。

short_sentences.en: Our new line of sport shoes is selling well.
short_sentences.zh: 我們的新款運動鞋賣得很好。

short_sentences.en: The new SaaS product line targets mid-sized enterprise clients.
short_sentences.zh: 這條新的 SaaS 產品線鎖定中型企業客戶。

short_sentences.en: We are still negotiating with the vendor on price per unit.
short_sentences.zh: 我們還在跟供應商商量商品的單價。

short_sentences.en: Every core service module must have deterministic unit tests.
short_sentences.zh: 每個核心服務模組都必須具備可預測的單元測試。

short_sentences.en: Maggie couldn't pay the full amount of the bill.
short_sentences.zh: 梅姬沒辦法全額支付這筆帳單。

short_sentences.en: The ingestion pipeline processes a huge amount of event logs every minute.
short_sentences.zh: 資料攝取管線每分鐘處理大量事件日誌。

packs.title: 名詞 Level 1 第 3 組（頁碼 94-95）

short_sentences.zh: 業務團隊本季完成了三筆年度企業合約。

words.meaning_zh: 名 價格；比例 / 動 給予評價

short_sentences.zh: 您可用優惠價在會議酒店預訂一間房間。

short_sentences.zh: 發布開始後，5xx 錯誤率隨即飆升。

short_sentences.zh: 我們把檢討會議的每一項行動項目都列出來。

words.meaning_zh: 名 需求，要求 / 動 要求

short_sentences.zh: 隨著經濟成長，高層公寓的需求逐日俱增。

short_sentences.en: Compute resources scale automatically when traffic demand increases.
short_sentences.zh: 當流量需求增加時，運算資源會自動擴展。

short_sentences.en: In future, we have to hire staff in a more timely manner.
short_sentences.zh: 未來我們必須採取更及時的做法招聘員工。

short_sentences.en: Alerts must be triaged in a timely manner to protect our SLA.
short_sentences.zh: 告警必須及時處理，以保障我們的 SLA。

short_sentences.en: The customs officer opened my suitcase to inspect its contents.
short_sentences.zh: 海關人員打開我的手提行李箱，檢查裡面的物品。

short_sentences.en: Validate the request payload content before writing to the database.
short_sentences.zh: 寫入資料庫之前，先驗證請求酬載內容。

short_sentences.en: Perseverance is a key element to success.
short_sentences.zh: 毅力是成功的要素。

short_sentences.en: Idempotency is a key element in reliable payment processing.
short_sentences.zh: 冪等性是可靠金流處理的關鍵要素。

short_sentences.zh: 他對新企劃的看法過於樂觀。

short_sentences.en: From a system design view, caching reduces read pressure on the primary DB.
short_sentences.zh: 從系統設計角度來看，快取能減輕主資料庫的讀取壓力。

short_sentences.en: City officials came for a review of safety measures.
short_sentences.zh: 市府官員前來檢查安全措施。

short_sentences.en: Every pull request requires at least one thorough code review before merging.
short_sentences.zh: 每個拉取請求在合併前都至少需要一次完整的程式碼審查。

words.meaning_zh: 名 目標，目的；瞄準方向 / 動 瞄準

short_sentences.en: Our ultimate aim is to provide opportunities for jobless young people.
short_sentences.zh: 我們的終極目標是為失業的年輕人提供機會。

short_sentences.en: Our primary aim for this sprint is to cut p99 latency in half.
short_sentences.zh: 我們這個衝刺的首要目標是將 p99 延遲減半。

short_sentences.zh: 那條慢查詢很可能只是我們索引設定問題的冰山一角。

short_sentences.zh: 我們評估了執行專屬節點相較於無伺服器架構的成本效益。

short_sentences.zh: 這家工廠關閉數月後，如今又恢復營業了。

short_sentences.en: Scheduled batch operations run off-peak to avoid impacting live traffic.
short_sentences.zh: 排程批次作業會在離峰時段執行，以避免影響線上流量。

short_sentences.en: Thank you for your cooperation in organizing the fundraiser.
short_sentences.zh: 謝謝您協力籌辦這場募捐活動。

short_sentences.en: Smooth cooperation between product, QA, and backend teams sped up the launch.
short_sentences.zh: 產品、品保與後端團隊之間的順暢協作加快了上線速度。

short_sentences.en: I'm expecting company late this afternoon.

short_sentences.en: Our company provides B2B workflow automation tools for logistics firms.
short_sentences.zh: 我們公司為物流業者提供 B2B 工作流自動化工具。

short_sentences.en: She has passed the multiple rounds of job interviews.
short_sentences.zh: 她通過了一連串的工作面試。

short_sentences.zh: 這家新創公司完成了 A 輪募資，以擴編工程團隊。

short_sentences.zh: 搜救隊將進行一連串的實地演練。

short_sentences.zh: 我們召開了衝刺規劃會議，以對齊範疇與交付成果。

short_sentences.zh: 提升銷售額是新任執行長的首要任務。

short_sentences.en: Fixing the memory leak in the worker service is our top priority today.

short_sentences.en: The CEO started his career as sales representative.

short_sentences.en: A technical representative joined the call to review integration requirements.
short_sentences.zh: 一位技術代表加入了會議，以檢視整合需求。

short_sentences.en: There are many new features in the new software program.
short_sentences.zh: 這款軟體程式有許多新功能。

short_sentences.en: We gated the new checkout feature behind a feature flag for safe rollout.
short_sentences.zh: 我們將新的結帳功能放在功能開關後方，以便安全逐步發布。

short_sentences.zh: 吳先生上班的第一個月就得到三個國際客戶。

short_sentences.zh: 新的速率限制設定在重新載入後立即生效。

short_sentences.zh: 合約到期時，雙方皆有權取消合約。

short_sentences.zh: 很高興能見到子公司的員工。

short_sentences.en: It was a pleasure collaborating with the platform team on this release.
short_sentences.zh: 這次能與平台團隊合作發布版本，非常愉快。

short_sentences.zh: 請容我對各位的支持表達由衷的謝意。

short_sentences.zh: 我們想向事件期間協助的每一位同仁表達感謝。

short_sentences.en: I felt such a sense of relief when I received an acceptance letter.
short_sentences.zh: 收到錄取通知信時，我感到如釋重負。

short_sentences.zh: 看到 CPU 使用率回落到正常水準，讓人鬆了一口氣。

short_sentences.zh: 有些電視製作人會採取極端作法提高節目收視率。

short_sentences.zh: 我們加入了斷路器，作為防範下游中斷的保護措施。

packs.title: 名詞 Level 1 第 7 組（頁碼 102-103）
packs.description: 名詞 (Nouns) - LEVEL 1｜商用與軟體工程師語境｜共 10 個核心單字

short_sentences.en: The team developed a new method for shipping fresh fish.
short_sentences.zh: 那個團隊開發出運送新鮮漁獲的新方法。

short_sentences.en: Blue-green deployment is a reliable method for minimizing release downtime.
short_sentences.zh: 藍綠部署是降低發布停機時間的可靠方法。

short_sentences.en: It is standard procedure to fill out the form before entering the building.
short_sentences.zh: 進入大樓前先填寫表單為標準程序。

short_sentences.en: Always test the database rollback procedure in staging before production changes.
short_sentences.zh: 在進行正式環境變更前，務必先在預備環境測試資料庫回滾程序。

short_sentences.en: Gatner Zoo faces the prospect of more visitors as the weather becomes warmer.
short_sentences.zh: 隨著天氣漸暖，蓋特納動物園將迎來更多遊客。

short_sentences.en: The product shows strong growth prospects in enterprise automation.
short_sentences.zh: 這項產品在企業自動化領域展現強勁的成長前景。

short_sentences.en: After the chairman resigned, the company's fortune turned for the worse.
short_sentences.zh: 董事長辭職之後，公司的運勢每況愈下。

short_sentences.en: The company's fortunes improved once onboarding friction was reduced.
short_sentences.zh: 降低新戶引導門檻後，公司的營運狀況隨之好轉。

short_sentences.en: Steve works for an organization that plans various events for charity.
short_sentences.zh: 史帝夫工作的機構專門策畫各式各樣的慈善活動。

short_sentences.en: As our engineering organization grew, we split ownership by service team.
short_sentences.zh: 隨著工程組織擴大，我們依服務團隊拆分了權責歸屬。

short_sentences.en: Tomorrow is the anniversary of the founding of the company.
short_sentences.zh: 明天是公司成立的週年紀念日。

short_sentences.en: We ran a promotional campaign for our platform's fifth anniversary.
short_sentences.zh: 我們為平台五週年推出了促銷活動。

short_sentences.en: The conference attendees included members of the medical profession.
short_sentences.zh: 這場會議的與會者包含醫界專家在內。

short_sentences.en: Continuous learning is essential in the fast-moving software profession.
short_sentences.zh: 在快速演進的軟體專業領域，持續學習至關重要。

short_sentences.en: To find out your order status, please enter your 10-digit order number.
short_sentences.zh: 請輸入 10 碼訂單編號，以查詢您的訂單狀態。

short_sentences.en: Check the async job status endpoint to see if the export finished.
short_sentences.zh: 查詢非同步任務狀態端點，確認匯出是否已完成。

short_sentences.en: The work on the building will start next week if circumstances permit.
short_sentences.zh: 倘若情況允許的話，建築工程將從下週開始動工。

short_sentences.en: Under no circumstances should production secrets be committed to Git.
short_sentences.zh: 在任何情況下都不應將正式環境密鑰提交至 Git。

short_sentences.en: The team developed several solutions to architectural problems in the bridge design.
short_sentences.zh: 該團隊針對橋樑設計的建築問題想出了幾個解決方案。

short_sentences.en: Partitioning the queue gave us a clean solution to consumer lag.
short_sentences.zh: 將佇列分區為我們提供了一個解決消費者延遲的俐落解法。

packs.title: 名詞 Level 1 第 8 組（頁碼 104-105）
packs.description: 名詞 (Nouns) - LEVEL 1｜商用與軟體工程師語境｜共 10 個核心單字

words.meaning_zh: 名 影響；作用 / 動 影響

short_sentences.en: Who has had an influence on you?
short_sentences.zh: 誰是對你影響深遠的人？

short_sentences.en: Index design has a major influence on write throughput and query speed.
short_sentences.zh: 索引設計對寫入吞吐量與查詢速度有重大影響。

short_sentences.en: The engineers fixed a problem with a car model that had a tendency to overheat.
short_sentences.zh: 工程師解決了某種車型容易過熱的問題。

short_sentences.en: Unbounded caches have a tendency to cause out-of-memory errors.
short_sentences.zh: 無上限的快取容易引發記憶體不足（OOM）錯誤。

short_sentences.en: It's a custom to eat turkey on Thanksgiving Day.
short_sentences.zh: 感恩節吃火雞是一種習俗。

short_sentences.en: Cross-border e-commerce orders require accurate customs clearance data.
short_sentences.zh: 跨境電商訂單需要準確的報關資料。

short_sentences.en: When you join our rewards program, you instantly get benefits, like free WiFi.
short_sentences.zh: 只要您一加入我們的獎勵方案，即可立即享有免費無線網路等福利。

short_sentences.en: Users earn reward points when they complete verified purchases.
short_sentences.zh: 使用者完成已驗證的購買後可獲得獎勵點數。

words.meaning_zh: 名 試圖，嘗試 / 動 試圖做…

short_sentences.en: Roger made an attempt to finish the project early.
short_sentences.zh: 羅傑試著提前完成企劃。

short_sentences.en: Each webhook delivery allows up to five retry attempts with backoff.
short_sentences.zh: 每次 Webhook 投遞最多允許五次搭配退避策略的重試嘗試。

short_sentences.en: The majority of the board of directors voted to accept the supplier contract.
short_sentences.zh: 董事會多數成員投票同意接受供應商的合約。

short_sentences.en: The majority of our API traffic comes from mobile clients.
short_sentences.zh: 我們大部分的 API 流量來自行動端客戶端。

short_sentences.en: The residents of the small village tend to live long lives.
short_sentences.zh: 這個小村莊的居民通常都很長壽。

short_sentences.en: The smart building app helps residents submit maintenance requests online.
short_sentences.zh: 智慧建築 App 協助住戶線上提交維修申請。

short_sentences.en: Patti Weld considered it a great honor to be chosen Author of the Year.
short_sentences.zh: 派蒂．維德認為獲選為年度作家是極大的榮譽。

short_sentences.en: We named the internal testing cluster in honor of a founding engineer.
short_sentences.zh: 我們以一位創始工程師的名字命名了內部測試叢集。

short_sentences.en: Please refer to the information packet attached for further details.
short_sentences.zh: 請參考附件的資料封包了解詳情。

short_sentences.en: Packet loss between availability zones caused intermittent timeouts.
short_sentences.zh: 可用區之間的封包遺失導致間歇性逾時。

short_sentences.en: The newscaster waited for a development in the breaking news story.
short_sentences.zh: 新聞播報員等待著突發新聞的最新進展。

short_sentences.en: Share any new developments on the vendor integration in the daily standup.
short_sentences.zh: 在每日站會中分享供應商整合的最新進展。

packs.title: 名詞 Level 1 第 9 組（頁碼 106-107）
packs.description: 名詞 (Nouns) - LEVEL 1｜商用與軟體工程師語境｜共 10 個核心單字

short_sentences.en: There is controversy over the plans to outsource some business functions.
short_sentences.zh: 將部分企業功能外包出去的計畫引發爭議。

short_sentences.en: The proposed pricing tier change sparked debate among enterprise customers.
short_sentences.zh: 擬議的定價方案調整在企業客戶間引發了討論。

short_sentences.en: He received a caution from his doctor about too much fat in his diet.
short_sentences.zh: 醫生警告他的飲食攝取過多脂肪。

short_sentences.en: Proceed with caution when running schema migrations on large tables.
short_sentences.zh: 在大型資料表上執行結構描述遷移時請謹慎行事。

words.meaning_zh: 名 關心的事，關切 / 動 擔心

short_sentences.en: The rising unemployment rate has become a concern to the state government.
short_sentences.zh: 節節攀升的失業率已成為州政府關切的問題。

short_sentences.en: Cold-start latency is a primary concern for real-time inference APIs.
short_sentences.zh: 冷啟動延遲是即時推論 API 的主要疑慮。

short_sentences.en: Eve is a friendly person and has a good attitude toward work.
short_sentences.zh: 伊芙是個很友善的人，也具備良好的工作態度。

short_sentences.en: A blameless attitude during post-mortems encourages honest root-cause analysis.
short_sentences.zh: 事後檢討時抱持不究責的態度，能鼓勵坦誠的根因分析。

short_sentences.en: The rumor about Ms. Davidson's retirement quickly spread around the office.
short_sentences.zh: 戴維森小姐要退休的謠言一下子就傳遍了整個辦公室。

short_sentences.en: Leadership clarified the reorganization plans to stop office rumors.
short_sentences.zh: 管理層說明了組織調整計畫，以平息辦公室傳聞。

short_sentences.en: Higher market share was the outcome of the two companies' merger.
short_sentences.zh: 兩家公司合併的結果迎來更高的市占率。

short_sentences.en: The desired outcome of the refactor is cleaner boundaries and faster builds.
short_sentences.zh: 這次重構的期望結果是更清晰的邊界與更快的建置速度。

words.meaning_zh: 名 目標，目的 / 形 客觀的

short_sentences.en: Our main objective is to deliver packages as quickly as possible.
short_sentences.zh: 我們的主要目標是盡快送達包裹。

short_sentences.en: Our main objective is to maintain 99.95% availability across all regions.
short_sentences.zh: 我們的主要目標是在所有區域維持 99.95% 的可用性。

short_sentences.en: The purpose of the event is to raise money for children's charities.
short_sentences.zh: 這場活動的目的在於幫兒童慈善機構募款。

short_sentences.en: We collect anonymized telemetry for the purpose of performance tuning.
short_sentences.zh: 我們收集匿名遙測資料是為了進行效能調校。

short_sentences.en: Findings on the latest consumer survey are posted on our website.
short_sentences.zh: 最新的消費者調查結果已公布在我們的網站上。

short_sentences.en: The profiling findings pointed to lock contention on a hot database row.
short_sentences.zh: 效能分析的發現指向某個熱點資料庫列的鎖定競爭。

words.meaning_zh: 名 浪費，濫用 / 動 浪費

short_sentences.en: That new movie was just a waste of time.
short_sentences.zh: 看那部新電影簡直是浪費時間。

short_sentences.en: Over-provisioning idle instances leads to unnecessary cloud resource waste.
short_sentences.zh: 過度配置閒置實例會造成不必要的雲端資源浪費。

packs.title: 名詞 Level 1 第 10 組（頁碼 108-109）
packs.description: 名詞 (Nouns) - LEVEL 1｜商用與軟體工程師語境｜共 10 個核心單字

words.meaning_zh: 名 綜合大樓；情結 / 形 複雜的

short_sentences.en: The firm plans to develop another office complex downtown.
short_sentences.zh: 這間公司計劃在市中心蓋另一座綜合辦公大樓。

short_sentences.en: The payment settlement flow is one of the most complex parts of the system.
short_sentences.zh: 金流清算流程是系統中最複雜的部分之一。

short_sentences.en: I work for the company on a contract basis.
short_sentences.zh: 我依約聘制為這家公司工作。

short_sentences.en: We rotate API keys and review access logs on a monthly basis.
short_sentences.zh: 我們每月定期輪替 API 金鑰並審查存取紀錄。

short_sentences.en: The firm is known for being a patron of the arts.
short_sentences.zh: 這間公司以贊助藝術產業聞名。

short_sentences.en: Repeat patrons account for most of the neighborhood cafe's weekday orders.
short_sentences.zh: 回頭客占了這家社區咖啡廳平日訂單的大多數。

words.meaning_zh: 保險項目；新聞報導；覆蓋範圍

short_sentences.en: The insurance policy offers full coverage on fire and theft.
short_sentences.zh: 保單完全承保火災及竊盜險。

short_sentences.en: Increasing test coverage on critical billing logic reduced regression bugs.
short_sentences.zh: 提高關鍵帳務邏輯的測試涵蓋率，減少了回歸錯誤。

short_sentences.en: What is the frequency of your overseas business trips?
short_sentences.zh: 你多常去國外差差？

short_sentences.en: Lowering the health-check frequency reduced background load on the nodes.
short_sentences.zh: 降低健康檢查頻率，減輕了節點上的背景負載。

short_sentences.en: This vacuum cleaner works well on any kind of surface.
short_sentences.zh: 這款吸塵器在任何表面皆適用。

short_sentences.en: The API looked fast on the surface, but tail latency spiked under load.
short_sentences.zh: 這個 API 表面上看來很快，但在負載下尾端延遲卻飆升了。

short_sentences.en: We are a travel agency focused on Tuscany, Italy.
short_sentences.zh: 我們是專營義大利卡尼尼行程的旅行社。

short_sentences.en: We partnered with a digital agency to launch the new product campaign.
short_sentences.zh: 我們與一家數位代理商合作推出新產品行銷活動。

short_sentences.en: A panel of doctors reviewed several medical malpractice claims.
short_sentences.zh: 醫生組成的專家小組審查數件醫療疏失的索賠案。

short_sentences.en: An architecture panel reviewed the RFC before we approved the migration.
short_sentences.zh: 在核准遷移之前，架構審查小組檢視了這份 RFC。

words.meaning_zh: 名 改革，改良 / 動 改革

short_sentences.en: Overall reform is necessary for the current pension system.
short_sentences.zh: 現行的退休金制度需要進行全面改革。

short_sentences.en: Streamlining the release approval workflow was a much-needed reform.
short_sentences.zh: 簡化發布審核工作流是一項非常需要的改革。

short_sentences.en: We operate on the principle of putting the customer first.
short_sentences.zh: 我們的經營模式秉持顧客至上的原則。

short_sentences.en: Least privilege is a core security principle for cloud IAM roles.
short_sentences.zh: 最小權限原則是雲端 IAM 角色的核心資安原則。
